qwen3.5-2b: Small multilingual chat model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image and agent readiness are checked separately.
smollm3-3b: Text-only multilingual model from Hugging Face. A compact alternative for chat and writing; does not accept images.
granite-4.1-3b: IBM's compact text model for conversation and document tasks. Text only; tool use requires separate runtime checks.
lfm2.5-1.2b-instruct: Small text-only download from Liquid AI for everyday conversation. Uses the LFM 1.0 license; review its terms before organizational use.
gemma-4-e2b-it: Google's compact multimodal model. Bundle download includes its vision projector; image readiness is checked separately. The E2B name is not its total memory footprint.
llama-3.2-1b-instruct: Meta's latest compact model, excellent for edge devices
llama-3.2-3b-instruct: Great balance of size and capability for mobile/edge
phi-3.5-mini-instruct: Microsoft's efficient model with strong reasoning
mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3: Latest Mistral instruct model, excellent for code and reasoning
hermes-3-llama-3.1-8b: NousResearch's flagship instruct model with strong capabilities
mistral-nemo-instruct-2407: 12B parameter model with excellent instruction following
phi-4: Microsoft's latest reasoning model with strong performance
llama-3.3-70b-instruct: Meta's flagship 70B model with exceptional capabilities
nomic-embed-text-v1: Open-source embedding model, 768 dimensions, long context
bge-m3: Multilingual embedding model, 1024 dimensions, supports long context
speechPackage: Complete speech model package. Speech runtime and qualification are not included.
